item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused boundary tests
item.brief: Implement `retry_budget.py` according to the repository's `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests/checks and commit the completed work on the item branch. Acceptance criteria: the implementation matches the spec including all error and boundary behavior; focused tests exercise those cases; existing tests pass; commit is present. Do not change unrelated files.

pr.body: Implemented the documented pure function in retry_budget.py using only the standard library. Added tests for invalid values and validation ordering, exhaustion, zero values, uncapped Retry-After, strict budget boundaries, huge attempts, and saturation progression across small input ranges. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (10 passed) and `git diff --check` (passed). Reviewer found an early-saturation defect in the initial commit; corrected in a779cb8 and delta review passed.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded retry scheduling with validation and focused boundary coverage. Before: retry_delay was unimplemented; now: waits follow the specified backoff, Retry-After, attempt, and budget rules.
